title: The Festival of the Upside-Down Orchard
description: On harvest eve, the pear trees hang from the cavern roof. A ferryman raises a basket to catch the first falling pear.
alt: Pear trees grow down from a blue cavern ceiling. A ferryman on a raft reaches up with a basket as a pear falls through a beam of sunlight.
pairing: An imagined harvest-eve festival × an orchard growing down from a cavern roof
